batches.prompt: Create a precise 2-column by 2-row grid of FOUR independent SQUARE candid colour photographs, equal edge-to-edge panels on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048. No borders, gutters, captions, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or writing. These are author thumbnails for a British gardening book: John, the SAME real man in the supplied camera references, must be clearly recognisable in EVERY panel, head and practical gardening action both visible. Preserve his actual older adult face, receding short grey-brown hair, high forehead, real eye/nose proportions, short salt-and-pepper beard, relaxed familiar expression and ordinary body proportions. No beautifying, no younger replacement, no large square jaw or long rounded beard. When he looks down, copy the lowered-profile sheet: lower lip ahead of the chin, beard sloping back toward the throat, very little underside of jaw visible. Match the side-view reference where relevant. Photographic natural daylight, real soil and materials, modest crops, uneven foliage, subtle wear, no stock-photo posing. Use torso-close compositions legible at 29 mm square. Keep the face and task central, hands anatomically plausible and continuously attached, objects correctly supported, no extra fingers. Backgrounds must remain close crops of the referenced real locations, with correct materials and no invented garden layout. Each panel is a different moment; vary framing and expression modestly. Do not reproduce labels or camera-sheet typography. Reference roles: FACE-FRONT and FACE-LEFT supply identity; LOOKDOWN supplies the lowered chin/profile; H10 supplies checked-shirt/jeans outfit and the real greenhouse frame, central aisle and brick bed; L573 supplies genuine greenhouse harvest mood. The same checked overshirt open over a dark T-shirt, blue jeans, no cap, is worn in all four. ROW-MAJOR ORDER: TOP LEFT (09 Sowing a tray): John leaning slightly over a used greenhouse potting surface, concentrating on dropping a single tiny seed with thumb and forefinger into a black module tray, his other hand lightly steadying the tray, his face in a clear three-quarter view. TOP RIGHT (10 Potting on): John at the greenhouse bench, holding one small lettuce plug by its intact rootball just above a single small pot of compost, other hand supporting the pot, face visible with a slight smile of concentration; no detached leaves or mass of identical seedlings. BOTTOM LEFT (11 Watering under glass): waist-up oblique view of John beside the real greenhouse brick bed, holding an ordinary green plastic watering can with BOTH HANDS, one on its top handle, the other supporting the body/rear handle; spout and rose extend away from him over soil at the roots of uneven leafy plants; a gentle fine stream falls onto soil; face turned partly toward the bed. BOTTOM RIGHT (12 Gathering salad): John kneeling beside the greenhouse soil bed in three-quarter view, gently selecting an outer lettuce leaf with one hand and holding a modest metal colander with a few salad leaves in the other; his face visible and naturally intent, healthy irregular lettuce leaves and the brick bed edge correctly grounded. No large harvest piles.
